rule_summary: Two-step EQL sequence: a ProcDump process whose command line contains -ma, followed within a day by any file event whose name contains lsass and ends in .dmp, excluding users named admin*.

findings.title: Detection hinges on the attacker-chosen dump file name
findings.explanation: ProcDump and comsvcs write the dump to whatever path the operator types. `procdump -ma lsass.exe C:\temp\x.bin` never produces a file named *lsass*.dmp, so the second stage never matches and the whole sequence stays silent.
findings.recommendation: Alert on the dumping process itself (target + dump switch) and drop the file stage, or keep a file stage only as enrichment joined on process.entity_id.

findings.title: comsvcs.dll MiniDump (Atomic T1003.001 #2) is not covered
findings.explanation: The rule name promises LSASS credential dumping, but only ProcDump is modelled. rundll32 + comsvcs.dll MiniDump is built into Windows and is the most common living-off-the-land variant.
findings.recommendation: Add: (?process.pe.original_file_name : "RUNDLL32.EXE" or process.name : "rundll32.exe") and process.command_line : "*comsvcs*" and process.command_line : ("*MiniDump*", "*#24*")

findings.title: ProcDump MiniPlus (-mp) dumps are not covered
findings.explanation: -mp (MiniPlus) captures enough of LSASS for offline credential extraction and is a documented alternative to -ma.

findings.title: Drop the .keyword suffix on process.name
findings.explanation: ECS maps process.name as keyword; there is no .keyword sub-field.

strengths: Maps to the right ATT&CK tactic (TA0006 Credential Access)
Targets ProcDump's full-memory switch, the most common LSASS dump flag
suggested_query:
process where host.os.type == "windows" and event.type == "start" and
(
  (
    (?process.pe.original_file_name : "procdump" or process.name : ("procdump.exe", "procdump64.exe")) and
    process.args : ("-ma", "/ma", "–ma", "—ma", "―ma", "-mp", "/mp", "–mp", "—mp", "―mp") and
    process.command_line : "*lsass*"
  ) or
  (
    (?process.pe.original_file_name : "RUNDLL32.EXE" or process.name : "rundll32.exe") and
    process.command_line : "*comsvcs*" and process.command_line : ("*MiniDump*", "*#24*")
  )
)
